propositions: Five modules independently derive sidecar directory paths, each with separate symlink resolution logic, creating maintenance burden and repeated bug fixes across tickets

Multiple unresolved-symlink bugs were introduced and fixed separately in different modules (nuclear-calm-heron, intangible-ladyish-vicuna, conscious-weighable-spittlebug), indicating a pattern of divergent implementations
Three separate implementations parse .git gitfiles to resolve git directories with different failure sentinels, preventing unified refactoring without behavior changes
Consolidating all tracker-path derivations into a single StorePaths owner eliminates code duplication and ensures symlink resolution occurs at one canonical location
Guard test with join-scan validates that no module outside paths.py computes .rebar joins, preventing future divergent implementations
